description: Parse a skill definition from a configuration map under boundary conditions: a definition with no resources, a definition with several resources, a definition whose optional instructions field is present but empty, and a definition whose name and description are empty strings. The input carries the configuration map; the output reports each parsed field with the resource count and the resources in order.

cases.expected_output:
name=multi
description=Many
instructions=<none>
resource_count=3
resource[0]=https://a.example
resource[1]=rel/one.md
resource[2]=rel/two.md

name=blank-instr
description=Has empty instructions
instructions=
resource_count=1
resource[0]=https://x.example
